d:
“Chintamani Ganesha.” The song begins with a thumping tune and devotees worshiping lord Ganesha with enthusiasm. Thereon, the song reverberates an atmosphere of welcoming the Lord Ganesha who is looked upon as a saviour for all. The words tag along, “Dhol baaje taal baaje aa gae hain sab ke raaje” It’s calming to hear these words. Soon, Daler is seen playing a dhol; his voice brings in a soulful experience and sets the mood. And then, he comes up with repeated hypnotic hymns: Morya Re Morya Ganpati Bappa Morya, asking lord Ganesh to protect the world as it faces a large fire pit.
